Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so build armor and don’t give her an advantage then. Malzahar becomes relatively stronger late, so move with your allies, but stand away from terrain to avoid Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Qiyana.build: Start with Cloth Armor to endure the lane and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since Qiyana’s main damage is physical, build armor first and rush Zhonya’s Hourglass so you can survive her instant engage.
Qiyana.combo: For a trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Qiyana and refresh Malefic Visions. When you have a kill angle, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress her and give Voidlings time to attack.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, don’t go in right away; she can still escape with Qiyana E Audacity. In particular, let her engage pass, then catch her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp before Qiyana E Audacity comes back.
Qiyana.fight: Keep your distance while Malzahar P Void Shift is active, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity as she engages. Counterattack when Qiyana has used her mobility and remains in front of you.
Qiyana.laning: Push the lane with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Qiyana occupied farming, but don’t push forward without vision.
Qiyana.teamfight: Fight from a position where your allies can protect you, away from walls and narrow passages. Use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity as she engages, then suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp after the follow-up engage is over.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal roots when she has the river element and can ambush from stealth with the brush element, so watch which element she holds and adjust your distance. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits a wall, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or encounter her in a narrow path by the river.

Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, don't stand on top of your allies; watch out for the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. When Annie steps forward, interrupt the start of her abilities with Malzahar Q Call of the Void or suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Annie.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie deals mostly magic damage, and Malzahar has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.combo: Trade with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. When you have an angle to kill Annie, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so your Voidlings keep attacking during the suppression.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie has just used Annie P Pyromania's stun is your chance to go in. Annie has no mobility, so you can close the distance and suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp, but don't enter her range first while her stun is ready.
Annie.fight: Pressure Annie after Annie P Pyromania's stun is down. If you can close the distance, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send in Malzahar W Void Swarm, then silence her with Malzahar Q Call of the Void to continue dealing damage.
Annie.laning: Clear the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm, but don't push the lane blindly without vision.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania is ready to stun, stay outside the range of her abilities. After being hit by the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, move away because Tibbers will keep dealing damage there.

Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, don't start small fights against Galio's team in other lanes either. In teamfights, save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero's Entrance from engaging. After the enemy's follow-up engage is over, suppress a priority target or the champion who engaged with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Galio.build: Galio deals primarily magic damage, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and build magic resistance early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots to prepare for Galio's chained crowd control.
Galio.combo: For trades, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence him and refresh Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration. When you have a chance to kill him, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so the Voidlings can attack during the suppression. While Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, don't commit your damage; first move out of taunt range.
Galio.escape: Don't engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; look for the window before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back up. Position yourself so you won't be hit by Galio's taunt and knock-up in succession, then suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Galio.fight: Malzahar has no escape spell, so first keep enough distance to avoid Galio E Justice Punch and Galio W Shield of Durand. Push the lane when Galio has spent mana on using his abilities to clear the wave. For trades, cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions, then send in Malzahar W Void Swarm. Prioritize saving Malzahar Q Call of the Void for when you need to stop Galio's engage.
Galio.laning: Check that Malzahar P Void Shift is active, and don't push the wave blindly with Malzahar E Malefic Visions when you lack vision. When it's safe to push, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Galio occupied farming and limit his time to intervene in other lanes.
Galio.phase: Malzahar becomes more favored as he survives the early game and builds strength, so later, hold a side lane with vision and apply pressure with your ultimate.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, the damage he takes is reduced, so stop attacking and walk out of taunt range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its backward windup, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop his engage. Avoid the overlapping gusts from Galio Q Winds of War, and immediately leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don't stand in a straight line with allied minions. Watch for Lissandra E Glacial Path to bring her in so she can follow with the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. If Malzahar P Void Shift is down, create distance, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop her engage.
Lissandra.teamfight: Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path has been used before deciding to engage. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop her engage, and use Malzahar R Nether Grasp after the enemy's follow-up engage is over, from a position where your allies can protect you. If you don't have an angle to catch a priority target, suppress Lissandra as she engages to stop her from following through.
Lissandra.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance, and get tenacity to help against her root and stun.
Lissandra.combo: Trade in this order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. To finish her off, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp to keep dealing damage while she is suppressed. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, spread out your damage until the damage immunity from her self-cast ends.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path is your chance to close the distance. Suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp while the claw is traveling to prevent her from recasting to teleport. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, it's a good time to trade.
Lissandra.fight: Look for a trade right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send in Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to aim for a silence and refresh E's duration. Don't close the distance first while Lissandra E Glacial Path is available.
Lissandra.laning: Farm safely early and keep Malzahar P Void Shift up. Cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions on a minion to recover mana, and when you have vision, use Malzahar W Void Swarm to push the wave and keep Lissandra in lane. Don't push without vision or step forward to poke.
Lissandra.phase: Avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.

Talon.fight: When Talon engages with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin’s Path, use your saved Malzahar Q Call of the Void to try to silence him. Right after making Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, catch him while his mobility is down and suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. If Malzahar P Void Shift is broken, don’t force a fight; let Talon’s engage pass and wait for your allies.
Talon.teamfight: Group with your allies to meet Talon as he dives the backline, and look for a silence with Malzahar Q Call of the Void when he engages with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin’s Path. After Talon goes in, suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you to stop his engage. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down, don’t force the next fight.
Talon.combo: For a trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Talon and refresh Malefic Visions. When you have a kill angle, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress him and keep Voidling and Malefic Visions damage going. Cast R from a position where your allies can protect you so Talon’s follow-up engage can’t interrupt it.
Talon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Talon’s physical damage and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since Talon is an assassin who engages instantly, rush Zhonya’s Hourglass as well. Talon’s high magic resistance makes Malzahar’s magic damage easy to block, so include penetration in your build.
Talon.escape: The moment after making Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your window to counterattack and lock him down with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. If you’ve confirmed Talon R Shadow Assault has been used, look for a window where he can’t escape with stealth.
Talon.laning: Clear the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions, but don’t keep pushing without vision and expose yourself to a gank. If Talon roams, share his location and ward jungle paths; push the wave when it’s safe so he has to return to farm.
Talon.phase: Afterward, fight when Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, and play for the late game against Talon, who gets weaker as the game goes on.
Talon.watch: Talon’s P Blade’s End combo gets stronger if Talon W Rake hits on its return, so if you’re hit by the first strike, move out of its return path. Talon can engage with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy and Talon E Assassin’s Path, so save Malzahar Q Call of the Void. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can rely on stealth to escape, so don’t overchase.

Viktor.teamfight: Avoid stepping into Viktor W Gravity Field's area while sidestepping Viktor E Hextech Ray. After Viktor R Arcane Storm is down, suppress Viktor with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your team can protect you. If you don't have an angle on Viktor, use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on an enemy engage champion to stop the engage.
Viktor.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Viktor's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads, and build magic resistance first afterward as well. When you are inside Viktor W Gravity Field, walk out instead of waiting to be stunned.
Viktor.combo: Use this basic trade order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. Malzahar Q Call of the Void refreshes E's duration, so don't spend Q first. For a kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp, but suppress Viktor from a safe position after Viktor R Arcane Storm is down.
Viktor.escape: When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, immediately walk out of its area, then close the distance again. After Viktor R Arcane Storm is down, there's less risk of your Malzahar R Nether Grasp suppression being interrupted. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so close the distance and suppress him during that window.
Viktor.fight: Dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray and look for a chance to fight outside Viktor W Gravity Field. If he's in range, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send your Voidlings in with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then silence him with Malzahar Q Call of the Void. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so catch him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp after Viktor R Arcane Storm is down and when you can safely maintain the suppression.
Viktor.laning: Clear minions with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and push with Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Viktor tied to lane. Don't blindly push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions when you lack vision.
Viktor.phase: Viktor's scaling builds over time, so reassess trades when the glow of his staff changes color. Avoid forcing fights while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray is a straight-line skillshot, so don't stand in line with the wave; sidestep it. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave immediately instead of fighting inside it to avoid the stun. Viktor R Arcane Storm interrupts Malzahar R Nether Grasp when it appears, so don't rush to suppress Viktor while he can cast R.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, Zoe Q Paddle Star! can hit after you fall asleep, so move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep takes effect. A bubble that misses remains as a trap, so be careful around narrow paths without vision and brush entrances. Zoe returns to her starting point after using Zoe R Portal Jump, so remember that location.
Zoe.teamfight: If you can suppress Zoe with Malzahar R Nether Grasp, cast it from a position where your team can protect you. If you don't have an angle to catch Zoe, use Malzahar R Nether Grasp to lock down an enemy engage champion.
Zoe.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe's damage is mainly magic, so Malzahar needs magic resistance first. However, resistance can't reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.combo: When you have a clear angle to kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Your Voidlings attack during the suppression, and R Nether Grasp refreshes the vision's duration. Cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your team can protect you.
Zoe.escape: The moment after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your chance to engage. Even while Zoe R Portal Jump is down, Zoe has no other mobility, so you can suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Zoe.fight: Fight within range when Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. Trade by applying Malzahar E Malefic Visions, sending your Voidlings in with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then using Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Zoe and refresh the vision's duration. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, target the spot where she'll return.
Zoe.laning: Clear minions in a chain with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and push with Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Zoe tied to lane. Don't blindly push the lane when you lack vision.
Zoe.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, so surviving the early game gives you an advantage later.

Aurora.escape: Don't go in just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down; check whether Aurora E The Weirding and R Between Worlds are still available. In particular, look for a chance to catch her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back, when she has also spent her other mobility. Cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you so Aurora Q Twofold Hex's forced movement doesn't interrupt it.
Aurora.teamfight: After Aurora's follow-up engage is over, suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you. If Aurora gets a takedown, her leap ability's cooldown resets, so don't leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.build: Aurora deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration is a problem, include Morellonomicon in your core build.
Aurora.combo: Trade with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. Malzahar Q Call of the Void refreshes Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration, so you can keep dealing damage while Aurora retreats. When you have an angle to kill her, suppress her with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Aurora.fight: If Aurora uses W Across the Veil to become invisible, don't rush a targeted ability; wait for her to reappear. Counterattack when Aurora uses a mobility ability to engage and fails to get a takedown.
Aurora.laning: Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions to minions to clear the wave, and use Malzahar W Void Swarm to push when needed and keep Aurora in lane. Don't push the wave blindly without vision.
Aurora.phase: Avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again on its return, and that damage increases with the amount of health lost. If cursed, move out of the line between you and Aurora; if your health is low, retreat before it returns. Move away before Aurora R Between Worlds unfolds, or take a position to fight inside the zone.

Irelia.fight: Don't step forward to start a trade when Irelia can dash to you through a low-health minion. The moment after she uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the distance. As she starts to engage, use your saved Malzahar Q Call of the Void to aim for a silence. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Irelia.teamfight: In teamfights, focus Irelia to keep her from disrupting the fight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Irelia Q Bladesurge from engaging. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp after the enemy's follow-up engage is over, from a position where your allies can protect you.
Irelia.build: Use Cloth Armor early to survive, and buy Plated Steelcaps. Irelia deals mostly physical damage and Malzahar has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge is a problem, add Morellonomicon to your core build order.
Irelia.combo: For a basic trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. Since Malzahar Q Call of the Void refreshes Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration, cast it across Irelia's path. When you have a chance to kill her, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so your Voidlings can attack while she is suppressed.
Irelia.escape: The moment after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to go in. Suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp then so she can't escape. If Malzahar P Void Shift has been broken, keep your distance and position for your allies instead of immediately moving in to fight.
Irelia.laning: Cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions on a minion to clear the wave and recover mana, but don't keep pushing without vision. Don't leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and create distance when a minion is about to die.
Irelia.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as he stacks, so if you survive the early game, things become increasingly favorable as the game goes on. Avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Irelia.watch: Irelia can chain dashes onto you by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on low-health minions, so step back when a minion is about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you're trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear; crossing the boundary deals extra damage and heavily slows you.

Lux.teamfight: Approach spread out with your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity can't catch you all at once. After Lux Q Light Binding is down, suppress a priority target with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you. If you don't have an angle to catch Lux, use R to stop an enemy engaging champion.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, it's hard to dodge her follow-up abilities, so sidestep when Lux casts Q. Don't stand in a straight line with an ally, since it can root up to two targets even if an ally is in front. If a Lux ability hits you, create distance so you don't get hit by an attack that detonates the Illumination mark.
Lux.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Lux's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for magic resistance and tenacity.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding is down, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. R refreshes E's duration, and your Voidlings attack Lux while she is suppressed.
Lux.escape: Engage the moment Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability, so you can catch her once you close the distance to Malzahar R Nether Grasp's range, but if you use R while Lux Q is available, she may interrupt the cast.
Lux.fight: After baiting out and dodging Lux Q Light Binding, look for a chance to close the distance. Cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send in Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Lux and refresh E's duration.
Lux.laning: Use Malzahar E Malefic Visions to clear minions in a chain and push with Malzahar W Void Swarm, but don't mindlessly push when you lack vision.
Lux.phase: Avoid forcing a fight while R is down.

Vladimir.teamfight: Don't group inside Vladimir R Hemoplague's area, and if you're infected, step back until the effect ends. After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, suppress a key target with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your team can protect you. Use Malzahar Q Call of the Void when you need to interrupt an enemy starting a spell.
Vladimir.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Vladimir's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Add Morellonomicon to your core build to counter his healing, and consider Liandry's Torment against Vladimir, who stacks health.
Vladimir.combo: Trade in this order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Vladimir and refresh E's duration. To go for a kill, wait for Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to end, then use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. R refreshes E, and your Voidlings attack while Vladimir is suppressed.
Vladimir.escape: The window for Malzahar R Nether Grasp is immediately after Vladimir has used W Sanguine Pool and its effect ends. Vladimir has no skill to create distance on his own, so close the gap and catch him then. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for moments when you need to stop Vladimir from starting a spell.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then catch him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp as the pool ends. Vladimir is slowed while charging E Tides of Blood, giving you a chance to close the distance.
Vladimir.laning: Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions to a minion to recover mana, then clear the wave with Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Vladimir tied to lane. Don't push blindly when you lack vision, check whether Malzahar P Void Shift is active, and avoid exposing yourself at short range just to poke.
Vladimir.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, but leaving Vladimir unchecked early makes him difficult to deal with.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals and becomes empowered, so keep your distance when the empowered Q is ready. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If Vladimir R Hemoplague infects you, move back until its effect ends because you take increased damage.

Ahri.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first, but magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.teamfight: Watch for Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop her engage. Cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp on a key enemy champion from a position where your allies can protect you. If you don't have an angle to catch a key target, suppress an enemy who dives in and shut down the engage.
Ahri.laning: Use Malzahar E Malefic Visions to clear minions in a chain and Malzahar W Void Swarm to push, but don't push the lane without vision. Watch your spacing so small amounts of damage don't break Malzahar P Void Shift.
Ahri.combo: Trade with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. For a kill attempt, apply E first, summon W, then suppress with Malzahar R Nether Grasp so E's duration is refreshed while your Voidlings attack.
Ahri.escape: The window to go in is after you dodge Ahri E Charm and Ahri R Spirit Rush is down.
Ahri.fight: The moment after you dodge Ahri E Charm is your chance to attack. Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send your Voidlings in with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then silence her with Malzahar Q Call of the Void and refresh E's duration.
Ahri.phase: Avoid forcing a fight while R is down.
Ahri.watch: Dodge Ahri E Charm from behind minions, since getting hit can leave you exposed to her full follow-up damage. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit again on its return, and the return damage is true damage, so keep moving out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.

Akali.fight: Keep Malzahar P Void Shift active and focus on dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Akali when she engages and interrupt the start of her combo. Don't rush in while she still has multiple mobility abilities available, and cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Akali.teamfight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for when Akali engages. If she dives in, suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you and shut down the engage. Don't force a fight after Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Akali.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first, but also get health to prepare for the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution, which deals more damage based on your missing health. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for Akali's instant engage, and include magic penetration when dealing damage to her.
Akali.combo: Trade with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence her and refresh Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration. To lock Akali down for sure, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Akali.escape: Don't go in just because either Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down. Look for a window before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back, check her remaining mobility, then suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Akali.laning: Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions to minions to recover mana, then push the wave with Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Akali in lane. Don't push the wave blindly without vision, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for her melee engage.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once marked, its second dash will follow you even if you run away. You can't dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking. When Akali briefly appears as she enters Akali W Twilight Shroud, place Malzahar Q Call of the Void across her path.

Orianna.teamfight: Watch the ball’s position rather than Orianna herself, and stay out of Orianna R Command: Shockwave’s range. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on a key target from a position where your allies can protect you, after the opponent’s follow-up engage is over.
Orianna.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Orianna’s main magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Orianna.combo: For a trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Orianna and refresh Malefic Visions. When you have a kill angle, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress her and give Voidlings time to attack.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no mobility, so look for a chance to close the distance right after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her. If Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down, Malzahar R Nether Grasp is also less likely to be interrupted while you hold her.
Orianna.fight: Trade right after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her. Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, attach Voidlings with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then silence and deal damage with Malzahar Q Call of the Void across her path. Don’t stay forward for long trying to trade basic attacks with Orianna.
Orianna.laning: Chain-clear minions with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and push with Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Orianna tied to the lane. Don’t mindlessly push when you lack vision.
Orianna.phase: Malzahar is weak early, so endure by dodging Orianna’s poke and empowered basic attacks. Don’t force a fight after using Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Orianna.watch: Position yourself based on where the ball lands after Orianna Q Command: Attack. Avoid the area around the ball, where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Orianna P Clockwork Windup empowers her basic attacks, so don’t trade while taking repeated attacks early on.

TwistedFate.fight: Don’t approach while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is ready. Once he uses the Gold Card or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions first and fight. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
TwistedFate.teamfight: If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny’s movement and he is in range, interrupt him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on a key target from a position where your allies can protect you; if you don’t have that angle, lock down an enemy who is engaging. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for the moment you need to interrupt an opponent’s engage.
TwistedFate.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Twisted Fate’s magic damage early. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.combo: For a trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Twisted Fate and refresh Malefic Visions. When you have a chance to kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so Voidlings keep attacking while he’s suppressed.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is used is your chance to close the distance.
TwistedFate.laning: After checking vision, push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Twisted Fate tied to the lane.
TwistedFate.phase: Malzahar gains an advantage as he endures the early game and scales.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a Gold Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards is area poke, so dodge it and maintain Malzahar P Void Shift.

Xerath.teamfight: Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress one key enemy, but watch for crowd control that can interrupt the cast, such as Xerath E Shocking Orb, and cast from a position where your team can protect you. If you can't target a key enemy, use it on an opponent who is engaging. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt an enemy as they start a spell.
Xerath.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Xerath's main damage is magic, so Malzahar should build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: Trade by applying Malzahar E Malefic Visions first, sending your Voidlings in with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then using Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Xerath and refresh E's duration. When Xerath E Shocking Orb is down and you can cast safely, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions, Malzahar W Void Swarm, then Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress him.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. You can also approach while Xerath is channeling Xerath R Rite of the Arcane and unable to move, if you have a position where you can dodge it.
Xerath.fight: Instead of trading from long range, close the distance after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. While Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse, sidestep and look for a chance to approach him while he's slowed.
Xerath.laning: Early on, avoid heavy damage by keeping Malzahar P Void Shift active, even if you have to give up a few CS. Use Malzahar E Malefic Visions to clear minions in a chain and recover mana, but don't push the lane blindly when you lack vision. After Xerath spends a lot of mana poking, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, so surviving the early game gives you an advantage later. Avoid forcing fights while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and sidestep. Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb, since getting stunned makes you vulnerable to follow-up attacks. Check often whether Malzahar P Void Shift is active, and start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Akshan.teamfight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for Akshan E Heroic Swing's engage, and if you can catch Akshan, use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you. If Akshan has marked you as a Scoundrel, don't face him alone; fight outside his finishing range. Keep vision around the river and jungle walls to spot Akshan W Going Rogue's camouflaged approach, and move together with your allies.
Akshan.build: Akshan deals mostly physical damage, and Malzahar has relatively low armor, so start with Cloth Armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. If you need to handle an instant engage, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Akshan.combo: For a standard trade, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send your Voidlings in with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence him and refresh E's duration. If Akshan E Heroic Swing is down and you're going for a kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Your Voidlings attack during the suppression, and R refreshes E's duration.
Akshan.escape: The moment after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down is your window to close the distance or catch him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. When Akshan engages with E Heroic Swing, place Malzahar Q Call of the Void across his path to stop him.
Akshan.fight: Fight while Malzahar P Void Shift is active, and watch for Akshan E Heroic Swing. Right after Akshan uses E Heroic Swing, his mobility is down; look for a chance to silence him with Malzahar Q Call of the Void or suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Akshan.laning: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so don't try to avoid its poke by standing behind the wave. Without vision, don't push the wave blindly with Malzahar E Malefic Visions, and check that Malzahar P Void Shift is still active.
Akshan.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as he scales, so after you get through the early game, the matchup becomes increasingly favorable as the game goes on. Avoid forcing a fight while R is down.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so dodge its outbound and return path even from behind the wave. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to dash in, so watch for an engage near walls and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt it. If Akshan R Comeuppance targets you while your health is low, don't run alone into the open; move behind terrain.

Kassadin.teamfight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to use as Kassadin enters your backline with Kassadin R Riftwalk. Once Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down and the enemy's follow-up engage is over, suppress Kassadin with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you. Avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Kassadin.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and buy Mercury's Treads. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If his instant engage is threatening, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Kassadin.combo: For a basic trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Kassadin and refresh E's duration. For a guaranteed kill while Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Your Voidlings attack while he is suppressed, and R refreshes E's duration.
Kassadin.escape: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, look for a chance to engage. Confirm that Kassadin Q Null Sphere is also down, then suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp so he can't move. If Kassadin runs out of mana during a chase and can't use Kassadin R Riftwalk again, that's also a chance to counterattack.
Kassadin.fight: Start trades while Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for Kassadin R Riftwalk. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp when Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down and your allies can protect you.
Kassadin.laning: Cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions on a minion to clear the wave and recover mana. Don't keep pushing without vision, and avoid unnecessary ability use near Kassadin.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, watch for Kassadin R Riftwalk flanking from behind, and don't stand alone within his range.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere absorbs magic damage and interrupts channels, so don't use Malzahar R Nether Grasp before it is down. When Kassadin comes in with Kassadin R Riftwalk, save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to cast across his entry path. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows, so avoid using abilities unnecessarily near him.

Mel.fight: If you expect Mel W Rebuttal, bait it out first with an attack or a low-cost ability. Sidestep Mel E Solar Snare, and once Mel W Rebuttal is down, start trading with Malzahar E Malefic Visions. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you so Mel can't interrupt its cast with her follow-up root.
Mel.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Mel deals mostly magic damage and Malzahar has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Mel.combo: Trade in this order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Mel and refresh E's duration. To go for a kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so your Voidlings can attack while she is suppressed. Start after Mel W Rebuttal is down, and cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so dodging Mel E Solar Snare and waiting for Mel W Rebuttal to be down gives you a chance to close the distance. If Mel E Solar Snare is available, it can interrupt Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so dodge it before going in.
Mel.laning: Afterward, push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Mel in lane and create time to get vision or take an objective. Don't mindlessly push with Malzahar E Malefic Visions when you lack vision.
Mel.phase: Mel's permanent stacks from Mel R Golden Eclipse build over time, so keep in mind that she can become stronger as the game goes on.
Mel.teamfight: Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress one key enemy, watching for the enemy's follow-up engage and casting from a position where your allies can protect you. If you're targeting Mel, wait until Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down, then send in Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm before pinning her down with R. Hold Malzahar Q Call of the Void until you need to interrupt an enemy's ability startup.
Mel.watch: If you get hit by the center of Mel E Solar Snare, you'll be rooted and Mel Q Radiant Volley may follow, so sidestep it. If stacks of Mel P Searing Brilliance's Overwhelm have built up, you can be executed even while you still have health, so check how many times you've been hit and back away. Mel R Golden Eclipse can target anyone with remaining Overwhelm stacks regardless of distance, so wait in a safe place even after leaving the fight.

Sylas.escape: Don’t engage just because Sylas W Kingslayer is down. Your window is when Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is also down and hasn’t returned; suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp then. Since crowd control can interrupt Malzahar’s suppression while it’s being cast, use it from a position where your allies can protect you.
Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and Malzahar has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to endure the lane and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Fit Morellonomicon into your core build to counter healing from Sylas W Kingslayer.
Sylas.combo: For a trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Sylas and refresh Malefic Visions. When going for a guaranteed kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so Voidlings keep attacking while he’s suppressed.
Sylas.fight: Maintain Malzahar P Void Shift and wait for Sylas to engage. If Sylas uses E Abscond / Abduct to engage, interrupt him with your saved Malzahar Q Call of the Void, then look for a chance to suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer.
Sylas.laning: Afterward, cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions on minions to recover mana, then push the wave with Malzahar W Void Swarm so Sylas has to return to farm. Don’t mindlessly push the wave without vision, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to answer Sylas’s engage.
Sylas.phase: Don’t force a fight while the ultimate is down.
Sylas.teamfight: Right after Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, lock him down with Malzahar R Nether Grasp and kill him with your allies before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void until you can interrupt Sylas W Kingslayer or an engage with E Abscond / Abduct. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, prioritize dodging the follow-up chains over the first dash. The intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so move out immediately even if the first hit only grazes you.

Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your team so Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield doesn't grow by hitting multiple champions, and don't stand alone at the very back of your formation where Yone R Fate Sealed can reach you. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Yone's engage. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on Yone after his follow-up engage ends, from a position where your team can protect you.
Yone.build: Since Yone can engage immediately, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to evade an engage after Malzahar P Void Shift is broken. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don't focus on just one type of resistance, and consider movement speed to get out of his telegraphed attack areas.
Yone.combo: For a short trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to refresh E's duration. After Yone dives in, when you can reliably catch him, use E → W → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so your Voidlings attack during the suppression and E damage continues.
Yone.escape: Don't go in just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down. Check the status of Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed as well, and especially look for a chance to catch him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp before Yone R comes back up.
Yone.fight: Malzahar has no escape spell, so don't approach first when Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado is ready. If Yone comes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, stop his engage with your saved Malzahar Q Call of the Void, then use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where you can catch him.
Yone.laning: Clear minions and recover mana with Malzahar E Malefic Visions, but don't push the lane without vision or lose Malzahar P Void Shift to minor damage. If Yone's tornado Q is ready, keep your distance even if you have to give up a few CS.
Yone.phase: After that, look for chances to fight while Malzahar R is available, and don't force fights while it's down.
Yone.watch: When Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado is ready, it can lead into a knock-up and dash, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear if Yone repeatedly uses Q on minions. When Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, place Malzahar Q Call of the Void in his path. Also, don't stand alone at the very back of your formation, to avoid getting caught in Yone R Fate Sealed's area-of-effect knock-up and pull.

Corki.teamfight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Corki from engaging with Corki W Valkyrie. If Corki is your priority target, suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp after Corki W Valkyrie is down, from a position where your allies can protect you. If you don't have an angle on Corki, use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on another enemy diver to stop their engage.
Corki.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor given Corki's main damage, but first get out of range of Corki E Gatling Gun. Corki P Hextech Munitions' true damage cannot be blocked with resistances, so consider your total health as well.
Corki.combo: For trades, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. Malzahar Q Call of the Void refreshes Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration, so the damage continues while Corki backs off. After Corki W Valkyrie is down, when looking for a kill, suppress him with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Corki.escape: The moment after you force Corki to use Corki W Valkyrie is your chance to engage. His mobility is unavailable then, so close the gap and lock him down with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Malzahar R Nether Grasp requires you to maintain the cast, so use it from a position where your allies can protect you.
Corki.fight: Don't force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available. Right after Corki W Valkyrie is used, cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send in Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Corki and keep the damage going. Place Malzahar Q Call of the Void across Corki's path.
Corki.laning: Use Malzahar E Malefic Visions to clear minions in a chain, and use Malzahar W Void Swarm when needed to quickly push the wave and keep Corki in lane. Don't push blindly with Malzahar E Malefic Visions when you lack vision.
Corki.phase: Malzahar is favored later, but Corki also gets stronger as he builds items, so don't let him farm comfortably.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages nearby targets around the first one hit, so move out of range instead of hiding behind minions. Reposition to avoid getting hit in succession, especially by the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of trying to withstand it head-on. Immediately create distance while Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb has revealed your position.

Leblanc.teamfight: Wait for LeBlanc's follow-up engage from a position where your allies can protect you. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt LeBlanc W Distortion, and suppress LeBlanc with Malzahar R Nether Grasp to remove her from the fight. If Malzahar is hit by immobilizing crowd control while channeling Malzahar R Nether Grasp, the suppression is interrupted, so don't use it in the middle of the enemy team.
Leblanc.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and buy Mercury's Treads. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If her instant engage is threatening, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to avoid her engage and wait for your allies.
Leblanc.combo: For a trade, cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send in Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to aim for a silence and refresh Malzahar E Malefic Visions. If LeBlanc might come in with LeBlanc W Distortion, hold Malzahar Q Call of the Void until she commits instead of casting it first. For a guaranteed kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Leblanc.escape: The moment after LeBlanc uses LeBlanc W Distortion is a chance to close the distance, but it's more reliable to get close after the window to return to her original position has ended or after she has already used her return. After also avoiding the root from LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or confirming that the ability is down, catch her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Leblanc.fight: Be ready to fight while Malzahar P Void Shift is active, keeping your distance. If LeBlanc comes in with LeBlanc W Distortion, use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop her engage, then retaliate once she no longer has the opportunity to return to her original position. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Leblanc.laning: Farm early while keeping Malzahar P Void Shift up instead of stepping forward to poke. After securing vision, push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep LeBlanc in lane. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from vision.
Leblanc.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as he stacks, so if you survive the early game, things become increasingly favorable as the game goes on. However, avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is still on you, the next ability that hits you will deal more damage, so back away and wait for the mark to disappear. When LeBlanc enters with LeBlanc W Distortion, cast Malzahar Q Call of the Void across her path to interrupt her engage with a silence. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, move out of its range before it roots you.

Naafiri.escape: Don't go in just because Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Once Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate are down and R Hounds' Pursuit hasn't returned yet, catch her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Naafiri.teamfight: From a position where your allies can protect you, time Malzahar Q Call of the Void to Naafiri's engage and suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Malzahar R Nether Grasp is interrupted if you are disrupted while casting, so use it after the enemy's follow-up engage is over. When Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, don't get isolated, and retreat right after an ally dies so you aren't picked off one by one.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage and Malzahar has relatively low armor, so use Cloth Armor to survive early and buy Plated Steelcaps. Buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to withstand her engage, and add Morellonomicon to your core build order if the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate is a problem.
Naafiri.combo: When you can trade safely, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → W Void Swarm → Q Call of the Void, with Q refreshing E's duration. To go for a kill, wait until Naafiri W The Call of the Pack ends, then suppress her with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → W Void Swarm → R Nether Grasp.
Naafiri.fight: The moment after Naafiri E Eviscerate returns her pack is a chance to retaliate, but don't chase too far if she still has another mobility ability available. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void until you can interrupt Naafiri's engage, and trade with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and W Void Swarm when you can deal damage safely.
Naafiri.laning: Use Malzahar E Malefic Visions to clear minions in a chain, but don't push without vision or step forward to poke and give Naafiri an angle to engage with Naafiri E Eviscerate.
Naafiri.phase: In the mid game, watch for Naafiri roams and maintain broad vision. Malzahar gets stronger as he stacks, and Naafiri's pack is vulnerable to area damage in late-game head-on teamfights, so set up fights where your team stays grouped.
Naafiri.watch: If you are hit by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers the first time, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate and R Hounds' Pursuit are engage tools, so save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to cast across her entry path and aim for a silence. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can't be targeted, so use Malzahar R Nether Grasp after it ends.

Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility, but Syndra E Scatter the Weak can knock you back or stun you. Close the distance right after she uses Syndra E Scatter the Weak, avoiding the line of spheres, and cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Syndra.teamfight: Avoid areas with several Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres, and use Malzahar R Nether Grasp after the opponent’s follow-up engage is over so Syndra E Scatter the Weak can’t interrupt the suppression. If you can safely target Syndra, remove her from the fight with suppression; if you don’t have that angle, suppress the key enemy champion who engaged.
Syndra.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to endure the lane and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Syndra’s main damage, but also build health to account for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down and you have safely closed the distance, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Voidlings attack while she’s suppressed, and Malzahar R Nether Grasp refreshes Malefic Visions.
Syndra.fight: The moment after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down is your chance to close the distance. For a trade, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions first, attach Voidlings with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then silence Syndra with Malzahar Q Call of the Void to refresh Malefic Visions.
Syndra.laning: Chain-clear minions with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and push with Malzahar W Void Swarm when needed to keep Syndra tied to the lane. Don’t mindlessly push when you lack vision.
Syndra.phase: Avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Syndra.watch: Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push spheres to stun you, so move off the line of spheres when you see Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If Syndra has placed several spheres in an area, watch out for Syndra R Unleashed Power and reposition. Check often whether Malzahar P Void Shift is active.

Veigar.teamfight: Check Veigar's position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon is available first. Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm from a position where your team can protect you, then suppress Veigar with Malzahar R Nether Grasp if you get an angle to kill him. If you can't target Veigar, use Malzahar R Nether Grasp to stop an enemy engage champion.
Veigar.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Veigar's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads to prepare for the stun from Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.combo: Use this basic trade order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. To go for a kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress Veigar and give your Voidlings time to attack. Malzahar Q Call of the Void and Malzahar R Nether Grasp both refresh the duration of Malzahar E Malefic Visions already on the target.
Veigar.escape: The moment Veigar E Event Horizon is used up is your chance to engage. Veigar has no mobility, so you can close the distance and catch him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp, but cast it from a safe position because being stunned interrupts the suppression.
Veigar.fight: Check whether Malzahar P Void Shift is active, and close the distance after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Trade by applying Malzahar E Malefic Visions, sending your Voidlings in with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then using Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Veigar and refresh E's duration. Keep moving during the trade to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid being hit by Veigar Q Baleful Strike and giving him growth stacks. If needed, give up CS to keep Malzahar P Void Shift active. Don't blindly push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions when you lack vision.
Veigar.phase: Veigar's stacks keep growing into the late game, so check his position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon before joining an objective fight.
Veigar.watch: If Veigar E Event Horizon traps you, move inside without crossing the edge and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground marker and sidestep. If your health drops below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Zed.teamfight: In teamfights, save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to use when Zed comes in with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. If Zed engages, suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your team can protect you to stop his follow-up attacks. After using Malzahar R Nether Grasp, don't force a fight before it's available again.
Zed.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Zed's main damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark is physical, so build armor first. Since Zed can engage immediately, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well, keeping it ready to get through the moment his mark detonates.
Zed.combo: Use this basic trade order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Zed and refresh Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration. Once Zed's mobility spells are down and you have a clear opening, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress him. Cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your team can protect you.
Zed.escape: Right after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, look for an opening after the shadow disappears or Zed has already changed position. If you go in just because Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can escape with Zed R Death Mark, so the window to engage is especially before Zed R Death Mark comes back up. Suppress Zed then with Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Zed.fight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Zed from engaging with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark. Look for a chance to attack after Zed W Living Shadow has been used and the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already changed position. However, if Zed R Death Mark is still available, don't go in too deep; wait for that spell to be down too.
Zed.laning: Push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Zed tied to lane, but don't push blindly when you lack vision. Check often whether Malzahar P Void Shift is active, and save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for Zed's engage.
Zed.phase: Malzahar gets stronger and Zed gets weaker as the game goes on, so move with your team.
Zed.watch: When Zed engages with Zed W Living Shadow, watch the shadow's position and move outside Zed E Shadow Slash's slow area. If Zed R Death Mark marks you, damage builds up until it detonates, so interrupt Zed's follow-up attacks with Malzahar Q Call of the Void or Malzahar R Nether Grasp in the meantime. Be especially careful of Zed's engage while Malzahar P Void Shift is broken.

Anivia.teamfight: Fight in the open lane instead of narrow jungle paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt the start of the enemy's abilities. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on a key target from a position where your allies can protect you; if you don't have that angle, use it on an enemy who engages.
Anivia.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Anivia.combo: Trade with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → W Void Swarm → Q Call of the Void. Q refreshes E's duration and keeps the damage going. For a kill attempt, use E → W → R Nether Grasp, but if Anivia P Rebirth is still available, go in with allies who can break the egg.
Anivia.escape: The window to close the distance is after Anivia uses Q Flash Frost and W Crystallize. Suppress her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you. If Anivia P Rebirth has already been used, it's a better time to go for a kill.
Anivia.fight: Malzahar has no escape abilities, so first avoid getting in range of Anivia Q Flash Frost and W Crystallize. After she uses both abilities, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions and send in W Void Swarm to deal damage. Place Malzahar Q Call of the Void across Anivia's path to silence her.
Anivia.laning: Use Malzahar E Malefic Visions to clear minions in a chain, adding W Void Swarm when needed to keep Anivia in lane. Without vision, don't push the lane blindly with E.
Anivia.phase: Afterward, Malzahar gets stronger as he scales, so push the lane to buy time. Avoid forcing a fight after using R.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost detonates at its recast location and stuns, so don't just sidestep the projectile; move beyond its range. If you're hit by Q or caught in a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals greatly increased damage, so leave the storm immediately. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape.

Vex.teamfight: An ally marked by Vex R Shadow Surge should move toward your team to receive Vex's dash. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Vex as she engages, and use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on an engaging Vex from a position where your team can protect you. Low-health allies should move out of Vex's range first so she can't reset R with an initial kill.
Vex.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads. Vex's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Vex.combo: Trade in this order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void. Hit Vex with Q while E is on her to refresh its duration. When you have a chance to kill Vex, use E → W → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so your Voidlings can attack while she is suppressed.
Vex.escape: Vex has no mobility besides her ultimate, so when Vex R Shadow Surge is down, it's your chance to lock her down. If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are also down, look for a Malzahar R Nether Grasp opportunity.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are down. Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send your Voidlings in with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Vex and refresh E's duration. Cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your team can protect you.
Vex.laning: Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions to a minion to recover mana, then clear the wave with Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Vex tied to lane. Don't push the lane blindly with E when you lack vision.
Vex.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, so surviving the early game gives you an advantage later. Avoid forcing fights while R is down.
Vex.watch: While Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, watch for Vex to engage and check whether Malzahar P Void Shift is active. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so dodge with a short sidestep. If Vex R Shadow Surge marks you, move toward your team immediately.

AurelionSol.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on choices that only greatly increase your health.
AurelionSol.combo: After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, lock him down in this order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. R refreshes E’s duration, and your Voidlings attack the target during the suppression. Cast it where your allies can protect you so you can maintain the suppression safely.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment right after Aurelion Sol uses W Astral Flight is your chance to close the distance. Aurelion Sol E Singularity or R Falling Star / The Skies Descend can interrupt Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so engage after that crowd control is down, from a position where your allies can protect you.
AurelionSol.fight: When Aurelion Sol enters with W Astral Flight, cast Malzahar Q Call of the Void across his path to interrupt his engage with silence. For trades, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send in Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use the Malzahar Q Call of the Void you held back to silence him and refresh E’s duration. Cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where the enemy’s follow-up crowd control can’t interrupt it.
AurelionSol.laning: Cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions on a minion to restore mana, then use Malzahar W Void Swarm to push the wave and keep Aurelion Sol tied to lane. Don’t keep pushing without vision or let Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light hit you and stack Stardust.
AurelionSol.phase: Late game, Aurelion Sol grows stronger as his Stardust stacks permanently, so avoid risky fights when Malzahar R Nether Grasp is unavailable.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Hold Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt Aurelion Sol’s engage with silence when he enters with W Astral Flight. If you get a chance to catch Aurelion Sol, suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp after the follow-up crowd control is down. Late game, spread out so Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend doesn’t knock up several of you at once, and don’t bunch up in narrow passages.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your max health and stacks Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim. If you’re caught by Aurelion Sol E Singularity, walk out immediately; at low health, avoid even the edge. Late game, spread out from allies to dodge the knock-up and AoE shockwave from Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend.

Azir.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Azir's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and prioritize magic resistance.
Azir.combo: To catch Azir, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. The Voidlings attack during the suppression, and Malzahar R Nether Grasp refreshes Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration. Cast it from a position where your allies can protect you.
Azir.escape: The moment after you force Azir to use Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to close the gap. Once you confirm Azir R Emperor's Divide is also down, engage while reducing the risk of forced movement interrupting Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Azir.fight: After Azir Q Conquering Sands, move to the side while the soldiers are stationary and target Azir himself. For trades, cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions, summon Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence him and refresh the duration. When Azir tries to engage with Azir E Shifting Sands, place Malzahar Q Call of the Void across his path to stop him.
Azir.laning: Cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions on a minion to recover mana. Once you have vision, use Malzahar W Void Swarm to push the wave and keep Azir in lane. Look for opportunities to pressure with your jungler when Azir's soldiers disappear or he is low on mana.
Azir.phase: Azir also gets stronger as the game goes on, but Malzahar becomes more favored later if he survives the early game and scales. Avoid forced fights when Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Azir.teamfight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt Azir E Shifting Sands as he engages. Use Malzahar R Nether Grasp when you can catch Azir from a position where your allies can protect you. If you enter a narrow passage together, Azir R Emperor's Divide can push everyone back, so approach from different directions in an open area.
Azir.watch: Dodge the attack range and straight-line path of the soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise!. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves the soldiers and slows you, create distance. Avoid entering narrow passages where the wall left by Azir R Emperor's Divide is dangerous.

Ekko.build: Ekko deals primarily magic damage, and Malzahar has relatively low magic resistance, so first withstand it with a Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for Ekko instantly engaging and breaking Malzahar P Void Shift.
Ekko.combo: For trades, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence him and refresh Malzahar E Malefic Visions' duration. When Ekko E Phase Dive is down and you're going for a guaranteed kill, suppress him with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Ekko.escape: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, move outside its area to avoid the stun. Engage during the window when Ekko E Phase Dive and Ekko W Parallel Convergence are down, especially if Ekko R Chronobreak is down too.
Ekko.fight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Ekko E Phase Dive before he gets close. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive is down, look for a chance to suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp, but don't force a chase if Ekko R Chronobreak is ready.
Ekko.laning: Early on, farm while protecting Malzahar P Void Shift instead of stepping forward to poke. After securing vision, push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Ekko in lane.
Ekko.phase: Avoid forced fights while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to get close, his mobility is down, so interrupt his engage with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for the moment Ekko casts his engage spell, and use Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Move out of the path of Ekko Q Timewinder as it returns, and if you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don't chase, even if health is low.

Fizz.build: Fizz deals primarily magic damage, and Malzahar has relatively low magic resistance, so early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Fizz is an assassin who can engage instantly, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier as well to avoid his engage and wait for your allies.
Fizz.combo: For trades, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence him and refresh E's duration. When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and a kill opportunity opens, suppress him with E → W → Malzahar R Nether Grasp to give the Voidlings time to attack.
Fizz.escape: Don't engage just because Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down. The window to engage with Malzahar R Nether Grasp is right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, when he has lost both his attack and escape tools.
Fizz.fight: Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void and Malzahar R Nether Grasp until Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down.
Fizz.laning: Early on, keep Fizz in lane by clearing minions with Malzahar E Malefic Visions instead of stepping forward to poke. Maintain Malzahar P Void Shift, and don't push the lane blindly with E when you lack vision. Look for a trade when Fizz misses a last hit with an empowered attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident.
Fizz.phase: Malzahar gets stronger as he scales and is favored later if he gets through the early game, but avoid forced fights while R is down.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand near your allies and bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster first. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt Fizz's engage. After Fizz engages and E is down, suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Fizz.watch: If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz may use Fizz Q Urchin Strike to engage at that moment, so save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to place across his path.

Hwei.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance rather than armor to prepare for Hwei's damage, and account for the risk of being caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Hwei.combo: When looking for a kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp. R refreshes E's duration and the Voidlings attack during the suppression, so cast it from a position where your allies can protect you.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility spell, so close the gap after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Then suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp, but avoid positions where Hwei's follow-up crowd control can interrupt the cast.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used for poke or waveclear is your chance to close the gap. For trades, cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions, send in Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence him and refresh E's duration.
Hwei.laning: Push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Hwei in lane, but don't push blindly when you lack vision.
Hwei.teamfight: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, look to use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on Hwei from a position where your allies can protect you.
Hwei.watch: If you are caught by the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you may take the follow-up damage too, so don't step forward while Hwei has this ability available. If the first spell hits, immediately reposition to dodge the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Karma.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Karma's magic damage. Buy Mercury's Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Karma.combo: Trade in this order: Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void, aiming to silence Karma and refresh E's duration. If Karma W Focused Resolve is down and you can secure a kill from a position where your allies can protect you, suppress her with Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Karma.escape: If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move far enough away to break the tether before it roots you. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down, look for a chance to catch her with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, wait for it to end.
Karma.fight: Maintain Malzahar P Void Shift while avoiding Karma's poke, and don't step forward to start trades. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E has ended, start trading with Malzahar E Malefic Visions.
Karma.laning: Check vision, then cast Malzahar E Malefic Visions on a minion and use Malzahar W Void Swarm to push the wave and keep Karma in lane.
Karma.phase: In the mid and late game, avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Karma.teamfight: Wait to engage while Karma W Focused Resolve is available or the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active. Hold Malzahar Q Call of the Void to interrupt an enemy's ability startup, and use Malzahar R Nether Grasp on a priority target or an engaging champion from a position where your allies can protect you.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, and the ground left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q explodes again after a short delay. If you get hit, move out of the area immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance before it roots you.

Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to endure the lane and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Ryze.combo: When you have a sure kill on Ryze, apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions first, summon Voidlings with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then suppress him with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. Since Malzahar R Nether Grasp refreshes Malefic Visions, cast it from a position where your allies can protect you.
Ryze.escape: The window while Ryze R Realm Warp is down is your chance to engage. If you’ve dodged Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison, look for an angle to lock him down with Malzahar R Nether Grasp. If Ryze is channeling Ryze R Realm Warp, you can cancel it with Malzahar Q Call of the Void’s silence or Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression.
Ryze.fight: Try to trade after dodging Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison. Apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions, attach Voidlings with Malzahar W Void Swarm, then use Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Ryze and refresh Malefic Visions.
Ryze.laning: After checking vision, push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm to keep Ryze tied to the lane.
Ryze.phase: Malzahar gains an advantage as he gets through the early game and scales, so avoid forcing a fight while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is down.
Ryze.teamfight: If Ryze tries to join a fight with Ryze R Realm Warp, interrupt the cast with Malzahar Q Call of the Void’s silence or Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression. In a fight, stop Ryze’s chain attacks with Malzahar R Nether Grasp from a position where your allies can protect you.
Ryze.watch: When Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze Q Overload is empowered, and the follow-up Ryze W Rune Prison can root you. Prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux; if you’re hit by the mark, separate from your allies and keep your distance until it fades.

Yasuo.build: Weather the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal primarily physical damage, and Malzahar has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: For a basic trade, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar Q Call of the Void to silence Yasuo and refresh Malzahar E Malefic Visions’ duration. When you have a clear opportunity to secure a kill, use Malzahar E Malefic Visions → Malzahar W Void Swarm → Malzahar R Nether Grasp so your Voidlings can attack while Yasuo is suppressed.
Yasuo.escape: Look for an engage right after Yasuo throws a tornado, when the stacks on Yasuo Q Steel Tempest reset. Don’t engage just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down. Catch Yasuo with Malzahar R Nether Grasp before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, when crowd control can be applied together with your suppression.
Yasuo.fight: Start trades after removing Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light damage. Right after Yasuo throws a tornado, he has no way to knock you up for a while, so look for a chance to apply Malzahar E Malefic Visions. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void for when Yasuo uses Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to engage; don’t spend it beforehand.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and on your side of the lane to reduce the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use as stepping stones, and maintain your distance. When you lack vision, don’t blindly push the wave with Malzahar E Malefic Visions and Malzahar W Void Swarm.
Yasuo.phase: Malzahar is weak early, so play patiently while maintaining your distance and protecting Malzahar P Void Shift. Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, so you’ll have the advantage after getting through the early game.
Yasuo.teamfight: Wait for Yasuo’s follow-up engage from a position where your allies can protect you, then use Malzahar R Nether Grasp to suppress a key target or Yasuo if he engages. Save Malzahar Q Call of the Void to stop Yasuo when he engages with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to reach Malzahar, so be careful with your spacing around large minion waves. After Yasuo hits Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, he can knock you up with a tornado; watch for the visual effect and sidestep out of its line. Malzahar has no escape skill, so once caught, he can easily take follow-up attacks.
